title: About Policy Recommendations for Resource Groups

blocks.text: Microsegmentation provides policy recommendations for resource groups based on historical network flows. Recommendations are listed on a page within the Application Map and organized by managed and unmanaged flows. You can filter managed and unmanaged flows by direction (i.e., inbound and outbound).
To view policy recommendations for a resource group:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Dashboard > Microsegmentation Application Map.
On the Application Map, configure the filters as desired, then select a resource group.
The drawer for the resource group opens.
In the drawer, click Review Recommended Policies.
See image.
The Policy Recommendation page for the resource group appears.

blocks.text: The Policy Recommendation page for a resource group provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Review policy recommendations for a resource group based on flows from the last 14 days.
Accept and apply recommendations without conflicts for quick and targeted policy creation.
Resolve conflicts in recommendations, streamlining your organization's ports and policies.

blocks.heading: About Policy Recommendations for Resource Groups

blocks.text: On the Policy Recommendation page for a resource group, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Show or hide available columns.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.

Filter the table information. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results. By default, no filters are applied.
See image.
View a list of policy recommendations for your resource group.
Resolve policy conflicts.
View if the recommendation is accepted. This means the recommendation can be reviewed and applied as a policy.
View flows protected by the recommended policy.
Edit a policy recommendation.
Revert a policy recommendation.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
View aggregated information about your policy recommendations.
Review accepted recommendations and apply them as policies. To learn more, see Reviewing Policy Recommendations for Resource Groups.
